-- schema for the orders service
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id UUID NOT NULL,
  total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' -- semicolons in comments; must not split statements
);
title: orders

title: idx_orders_customer ON orders

CREATE VIEW open_orders AS
  SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status <> 'closed';
title: open_orders

content: ALTER TABLE order_items ADD CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id);
